ipos.prose:
Right now the grey market is pricing the Manika Plastech IPO at a median premium of ₹10 — the midpoint of 7 trackers, whose quotes range from ₹7 to ₹15. The median is unchanged from yesterday. Note the disagreement: trackers are 80% apart, which usually points to a thin grey market where any single number deserves skepticism.

Set against the upper price band of ₹43, today's median implies an estimated listing gain of about 23.26% — a sentiment reading, not a forecast. On the demand side, the issue is subscribed 1.49× overall — modest so far. The issue is open for bidding now (11-16 Sept) — see the full IPO calendar for what opens next. Our confidence grade on today's number is medium (50/100); the full breakdown is below.

As a mainboard issue it trades in a deeper grey market, where quotes are typically steadier and more meaningful than on SME boards. The Manika Plastech IPO is expected to list on 21 Sep 2026. For the Manika Plastech IPO, one lot is 348 shares and the issue size is ₹125.50 Cr. See also Manika Plastech IPO subscription status. This Manika Plastech IPO GMP page is rebuilt frequently throughout market hours, so the premium above is today's, not a figure left over from the day the issue opened.

ipos.prose:
As of today, the Veegaland Developers IPO grey market premium is ₹15 at the median of 7 trackers, with quotes spread between ₹10 and ₹24. The median has slipped ₹5 since yesterday, pointing to softening unofficial demand. Note the disagreement: trackers are 93.3% apart, which usually points to a thin grey market where any single number deserves skepticism.

Set against the upper price band of ₹140, today's median implies an estimated listing gain of about 10.71% — a sentiment reading, not a forecast. On the demand side, the issue is subscribed 1.15× overall — modest so far. The issue is open for bidding now (10-15 Sept) — see the full IPO calendar for what opens next. Our confidence grade on today's number is medium (53/100); the full breakdown is below.

As a mainboard issue it trades in a deeper grey market, where quotes are typically steadier and more meaningful than on SME boards. The Veegaland Developers IPO is expected to list on 18 Sep 2026. For the Veegaland Developers IPO, one lot is 107 shares and the issue size is ₹210 Cr. See also Veegaland Developers IPO subscription status. This Veegaland Developers IPO GMP page is rebuilt frequently throughout market hours, so the premium above is today's, not a figure left over from the day the issue opened.

ipos.prose:
As of today, the Panchatv Bharat IPO grey market premium is ₹9 at the median of 6 trackers, with quotes spread between ₹7 and ₹11. That is ₹2 above yesterday's median — grey-market demand is firming. Note the disagreement: trackers are 44.4% apart, which usually points to a thin grey market where any single number deserves skepticism.

Set against the upper price band of ₹140, today's median implies an estimated listing gain of about 6.43% — a sentiment reading, not a forecast. On the demand side, the issue is subscribed 0.04× overall — modest so far. The issue is open for bidding now (10-15 Sept) — see the full IPO calendar for what opens next. Our confidence grade on today's number is medium (46/100); the full breakdown is below.

Being an SME listing, the usual caveat is louder: SME grey markets are shallow, tracker spreads run widest in our data, and a thin market is an easy one to move. The Panchatv Bharat IPO is expected to list on 18 Sep 2026. For the Panchatv Bharat IPO, one lot is 1000 shares and the issue size is ₹24.58 Cr. See also Panchatv Bharat IPO subscription status. This Panchatv Bharat IPO GMP page is rebuilt frequently throughout market hours, so the premium above is today's, not a figure left over from the day the issue opened.

ipos.prose:
The Hero Motors IPO grey market premium (GMP) stands at a median of ₹19.5 today, drawn from 6 trackers we monitor — with individual quotes running from ₹10 to ₹25. The median has climbed ₹10.5 since yesterday, a sign of strengthening unofficial demand. Note the disagreement: trackers are 76.9% apart, which usually points to a thin grey market where any single number deserves skepticism.

Measured off the ₹84 upper band, that premium works out to an estimated listing gain of roughly 23.21%; treat it as expectation, not promise. The issue is upcoming, with dates listed as 16-18 Sept; every open and upcoming issue is on the IPO calendar. Our confidence grade on today's number is low (37/100); the full breakdown is below.

As a mainboard issue it trades in a deeper grey market, where quotes are typically steadier and more meaningful than on SME boards. The Hero Motors IPO is expected to list on 23 Sep 2026. For the Hero Motors IPO, one lot is 178 shares and the issue size is ₹1,000 Cr. This Hero Motors IPO GMP page is rebuilt frequently throughout market hours, so the premium above is today's, not a figure left over from the day the issue opened.

ipos.prose:
The Jindal Supreme IPO grey market premium (GMP) stands at a median of ₹21 today, drawn from 6 trackers we monitor — with individual quotes running from ₹17 to ₹21. That is ₹1 above yesterday's median — grey-market demand is firming. Trackers differ by about 19% right now — moderate disagreement, so read the range rather than the median alone.

Measured off the ₹93 upper band, that premium works out to an estimated listing gain of roughly 22.58%; treat it as expectation, not promise. The issue is upcoming, with dates listed as 16-18 Sept; every open and upcoming issue is on the IPO calendar. Our confidence grade on today's number is medium (64/100); the full breakdown is below.

As a mainboard issue it trades in a deeper grey market, where quotes are typically steadier and more meaningful than on SME boards. The Jindal Supreme IPO is expected to list on 23 Sep 2026. For the Jindal Supreme IPO, one lot is 161 shares and the issue size is ₹124.88 Cr. This Jindal Supreme IPO GMP page is rebuilt frequently throughout market hours, so the premium above is today's, not a figure left over from the day the issue opened.

ipos.prose:
Right now the grey market is pricing the Kanohar Electricals IPO at a median premium of ₹236.5 — the midpoint of 6 trackers, whose quotes range from ₹232 to ₹240. The median has slipped ₹3 since yesterday, pointing to softening unofficial demand. Quotes cluster tightly across trackers, the mark of a comparatively liquid grey market.

Measured off the ₹632 upper band, that premium works out to an estimated listing gain of roughly 37.42%; treat it as expectation, not promise. On the demand side, the issue is subscribed 90.59× overall — strong. Bidding has closed; the premium now tracks expectations into allotment and listing. Our confidence grade on today's number is high (93/100); the full breakdown is below.

As a mainboard issue it trades in a deeper grey market, where quotes are typically steadier and more meaningful than on SME boards. The Kanohar Electricals IPO is expected to list on 16 Sep 2026. For the Kanohar Electricals IPO, one lot is 23 shares and the issue size is ₹1,055.74 cr. See also Kanohar Electricals IPO subscription status. This Kanohar Electricals IPO GMP page is rebuilt frequently throughout market hours, so the premium above is today's, not a figure left over from the day the issue opened.

The Glass Wall Systems IPO grey market premium (GMP) stands at a median of ₹49 today, drawn from 6 trackers we monitor — with individual quotes running from ₹45 to ₹51.2. The median has climbed ₹2.5 since yesterday, a sign of strengthening unofficial demand. Quotes cluster tightly across trackers, the mark of a comparatively liquid grey market.

Set against the upper price band of ₹182, today's median implies an estimated listing gain of about 26.92% — a sentiment reading, not a forecast. On the demand side, the issue is subscribed 81.65× overall — strong. Bidding has closed; the premium now tracks expectations into allotment and listing. Our confidence grade on today's number is high (81/100); the full breakdown is below.

As a mainboard issue it trades in a deeper grey market, where quotes are typically steadier and more meaningful than on SME boards. The Glass Wall Systems IPO is expected to list on 16 Sep 2026. For the Glass Wall Systems IPO, one lot is 82 shares and the issue size is ₹427.89 Cr. See also Glass Wall Systems IPO subscription status. This Glass Wall Systems IPO GMP page is rebuilt frequently throughout market hours, so the premium above is today's, not a figure left over from the day the issue opened.

ipos.prose:
Right now the grey market is pricing the Steamhouse India IPO at a median premium of ₹21 — the midpoint of 6 trackers, whose quotes range from ₹20 to ₹22. The median is unchanged from yesterday. Quotes cluster tightly across trackers, the mark of a comparatively liquid grey market.

Measured off the ₹81 upper band, that premium works out to an estimated listing gain of roughly 25.93%; treat it as expectation, not promise. On the demand side, the issue is subscribed 32.07× overall — strong. Bidding has closed; the premium now tracks expectations into allotment and listing. Our confidence grade on today's number is high (81/100); the full breakdown is below.

As a mainboard issue it trades in a deeper grey market, where quotes are typically steadier and more meaningful than on SME boards. The Steamhouse India IPO is expected to list on 17 Sep 2026. For the Steamhouse India IPO, one lot is 185 shares and the issue size is ₹414 Cr. See also Steamhouse India IPO subscription status. This Steamhouse India IPO GMP page is rebuilt frequently throughout market hours, so the premium above is today's, not a figure left over from the day the issue opened.

ipos.prose:
As of today, the Vinod Texworld IPO grey market premium is ₹1 at the median of 5 trackers, with quotes spread between ₹1 and ₹20. The median is unchanged from yesterday. Note the disagreement: trackers are 1900% apart, which usually points to a thin grey market where any single number deserves skepticism.

Measured off the ₹94 upper band, that premium works out to an estimated listing gain of roughly 1.06%; treat it as expectation, not promise. On the demand side, the issue is subscribed 1.65× overall — modest so far. Bidding has closed; the premium now tracks expectations into allotment and listing. Our confidence grade on today's number is low (29/100); the full breakdown is below.

Being an SME listing, the usual caveat is louder: SME grey markets are shallow, tracker spreads run widest in our data, and a thin market is an easy one to move. The Vinod Texworld IPO is expected to list on 17 Sep 2026. For the Vinod Texworld IPO, one lot is 1200 shares and the issue size is ₹42.83 Cr.. See also Vinod Texworld IPO subscription status. This Vinod Texworld IPO GMP page is rebuilt frequently throughout market hours, so the premium above is today's, not a figure left over from the day the issue opened.

The Prasol Chemicals IPO grey market premium is still at zero across the 6 trackers we track — typical before dealers begin quoting, especially ahead of the price band or dates. We poll every tracker hourly, so the first quoted premium appears here as soon as it is published — dealers usually begin quoting around the price-band announcement, and almost always by the time bidding opens.

On the demand side, the issue is subscribed 26.22× overall — strong. Bidding has closed; the premium now tracks expectations into allotment and listing. Our confidence grade on today's number is medium (57/100); the full breakdown is below.

As a mainboard issue it trades in a deeper grey market, where quotes are typically steadier and more meaningful than on SME boards. The Prasol Chemicals IPO is expected to list on 16 Sep 2026. For the Prasol Chemicals IPO, one lot is 22 shares and the issue size is ₹500.00 Cr. See also Prasol Chemicals IPO subscription status. This Prasol Chemicals IPO GMP page is rebuilt frequently throughout market hours, so the premium above is today's, not a figure left over from the day the issue opened.

Infrax Renewable IPO GMP today stands at ₹0, with both trackers we monitor quoting the same nil grey market premium, implying no listing gain on the ₹104 upper price band. The issue is upcoming and bids run 9-11 Sept, so the grey market is currently pricing Infrax Renewable at its issue price rather than at a premium.

A structural caution applies: this is an SME issue, and SME grey markets are thin — our own data shows tracker disagreement is consistently widest here, and small markets are the easiest to paint. The Infrax Renewable IPO is expected to list on 17 Sep 2026. For the Infrax Renewable IPO, one lot is 1200 shares and the issue size is ₹47.96 Cr. See also Infrax Renewable IPO subscription status.
